name: Headway vs Lyra Health
title: Headway vs Lyra Health: Mental Health Platform Comparison 2026
description: Compare Headway and Lyra Health for mental health providers. Understand the difference between provider networks and enterprise employee benefits platforms.

summary.bottom_line: Headway and Lyra Health serve completely different purposes. Headway is a free provider network helping independent therapists accept insurance from individual consumers. Lyra Health is an enterprise B2B platform selling mental health benefits to employers. Therapists can potentially work with both - join Headway for individual clients and become a Lyra provider for employee benefit referrals.

key_differences.business_model: Headway (B2C provider network) vs Lyra (B2B employer benefits)
key_differences.client_source: Headway (individual consumers) vs Lyra (employees of client companies)

sections.heading: Headway vs Lyra Health: Different Platforms Entirely
sections.content: Headway and Lyra Health are often compared but serve fundamentally different purposes. Headway is a provider network that helps independent therapists accept insurance by handling credentialing, billing, and payments from individual consumers. Lyra Health is an enterprise mental health benefits platform that sells to employers, providing their employees access to therapy, coaching, and mental health resources as an employee benefit. These are complementary, not competing, platforms.

sections.heading: Business Model Differences
sections.content: Headway is free for therapists, earning revenue through a share of insurance reimbursements when therapists see clients through the network. Lyra Health charges employers per-employee-per-month (PEPM) pricing and pays providers contracted rates for seeing employees of their client companies. Therapists can potentially participate in both: join Headway for individual insurance clients and become a Lyra network provider for employer-sponsored referrals.

sections.heading: Scale & Capabilities
sections.content: Headway has 70,000+ credentialed therapists serving individual consumers across the US with clawback protection. Lyra Health covers 20+ million people directly through employer contracts and 100+ million through health plan partnerships, operating in 90+ countries. Lyra offers AI-powered matching (Lyra Empower), measurement-based care, and proven clinical outcomes (3:1 ROI, 2x faster recovery). Headway focuses on the administrative side of accepting insurance.

sections.heading: Provider Perspective
sections.content: For therapists deciding between these platforms, the question isn't either/or - it's whether to participate in each. Headway provides access to individual insurance clients with no membership fee. Becoming a Lyra provider gives access to employees of major companies as clients. Both can diversify your referral sources. Lyra requires meeting their provider standards; Headway has broader accessibility.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: Consider what client populations you want to serve:

recommendations.when: You want to accept insurance from individual consumers who find you through insurance directories or your marketing
You want access to employees of major companies as clients through employer-sponsored mental health benefits
You want to maximize referral sources - Headway for individual insurance clients, Lyra for employer-sponsored clients
You're building an independent practice and want free insurance credentialing with clawback protection
You're an HR leader evaluating mental health benefits for your workforce (not a therapist)

faqs.q: Are Headway and Lyra Health competitors?
faqs.a: Not directly. Headway is a provider network for individual insurance clients. Lyra Health is an enterprise employee benefits platform. They serve different customer segments - Headway helps therapists see individual consumers, Lyra contracts with employers to provide mental health benefits to employees.

faqs.q: Can I be on both Headway and Lyra Health as a therapist?
faqs.a: Yes, you can join Headway as a provider network member and separately apply to become a Lyra network provider. This diversifies your client referral sources between individual insurance clients (Headway) and employer-sponsored clients (Lyra).

faqs.q: How do I become a Lyra Health provider?
faqs.a: Lyra has a provider application process with clinical quality standards. Unlike Headway, which is open to licensed therapists, Lyra curates their network for evidence-based practitioners. Apply through their provider recruitment portal.

faqs.q: Which pays better: Headway or Lyra Health?
faqs.a: This varies by payer and contract. Headway rates depend on insurance reimbursements with Headway taking a share. Lyra pays contracted rates that may differ from standard insurance rates. Both can be valuable income sources for a therapy practice.
